from_speaker: Generative AI products do not provide significant revenue growth
not useful in the way that unlocks significant business value
products that have some adoption run at such a grotesque loss
our_interpretation: This is a combined claim about supplier revenue growth, customer business value and supplier losses.
Significant means commercially meaningful, rather than merely statistically detectable. No numerical threshold is invented.
Business value can include measured cost savings or improved output after implementation costs and service-quality effects.
Use January through March 2025, the latest broadly reportable completed quarter before publication.
A credible counterexample challenges the blanket wording, but one customer's savings cannot settle industry-wide revenue growth or product profitability.
No accounting basis or product population is supplied for the financial clauses.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence shows no commercially meaningful product-attributable growth or customer gains, together with large losses on adopted generative AI products.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes commercially meaningful product-attributable revenue growth, net customer value or profitable adopted products. Any conclusion must identify which clause it settles.
